text:
Situation: Methotrexate sodium injection has been on FDA's shortage list since 2023-03-13 and remains Current as of 2026-10-21, a duration of 43 months. Current inventory across Corvale sites provides 5.9 to 26.6 days of supply depending on formulation and location.

Why (FDA record): FDA first posted the shortage on 2023-03-13. An inspection of Elite Laboratories Inc. (FEI 3002644678) ended 2016-02-02 with an OAI classification. A later inspection of the same plant ended 2020-03-13 with a VAI classification, 1,095 days before the shortage posting. Zydus Lifesciences Limited (FEI 3007938603) had a VAI inspection ending 2023-03-24, 11 days after the posting.

Our position: Supply is critically low for injection presentations. The rule‑based best option is to purchase from Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer initiates purchase orders for methotrexate injection from Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc.; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer evaluates Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited, Antares Pharma Inc., Azurity Pharmaceuticals Inc., and Eugia US LLC as backup sources; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
3. Buyer monitors FDA shortage list weekly for status changes; requires no additional approval.
4. Inventory team allocates existing stock to highest‑acuity patients per clinical guidance; requires P&T Committee approval.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement while awaiting resolution of the FDA‑listed shortage.
